compatibility.dimension_rule: MISMATCH iff MISMATCH is highest-probability label and p_mismatch >= global mismatch threshold; otherwise UNSPECIFIED iff p_unspecified > p_match; otherwise MATCH

entity.MATCH: The evidence and claim refer to the same subject or entity.
entity.MISMATCH: The evidence and claim refer to different subjects or entities.
entity.UNSPECIFIED: The evidence does not specify enough to determine whether the subject or entity matches.

predicate.MATCH: The evidence addresses the same action, predicate, or attribute as the claim.
predicate.MISMATCH: The evidence addresses a different action, predicate, or attribute from the claim.
predicate.UNSPECIFIED: The evidence does not specify enough to determine whether the action, predicate, or attribute matches.

target_slot.MATCH: The evidence addresses the same target information slot as the claim.
target_slot.MISMATCH: The evidence addresses a different target information slot from the claim.
target_slot.UNSPECIFIED: The evidence does not specify enough to determine whether the target information slot matches.

temporal_scope.MATCH: The evidence matches the time period required by the claim.
temporal_scope.MISMATCH: The evidence explicitly refers to a different time period from the claim.
temporal_scope.UNSPECIFIED: The evidence leaves the time period required by the claim unspecified.

location_scope.MATCH: The evidence matches the geographic or location scope required by the claim.
location_scope.MISMATCH: The evidence explicitly refers to a different geographic or location scope from the claim.
location_scope.UNSPECIFIED: The evidence leaves the geographic or location scope required by the claim unspecified.

organizational_scope.MATCH: The evidence matches the organizational unit or queue required by the claim.
organizational_scope.MISMATCH: The evidence explicitly refers to a different organizational unit or queue from the claim.
organizational_scope.UNSPECIFIED: The evidence leaves the organizational unit or queue required by the claim unspecified.

conditional_scope.MATCH: The evidence matches the condition or trigger required by the claim.
conditional_scope.MISMATCH: The evidence explicitly refers to a different condition or trigger from the claim.
conditional_scope.UNSPECIFIED: The evidence leaves the condition or trigger required by the claim unspecified.

modality_quantification_scope.MATCH: The evidence matches the claim's obligation, permission, and quantification scope.
modality_quantification_scope.MISMATCH: The evidence explicitly uses a different obligation, permission, or quantification scope from the claim.
modality_quantification_scope.UNSPECIFIED: The evidence leaves the obligation, permission, or quantification scope required by the claim unspecified.

compatibility.overall_rule: COMPATIBLE iff no registered dimension is MISMATCH

covered_hypotheses.entity: The evidence explicitly provides the subject or entity required by the claim.
covered_hypotheses.predicate: The evidence explicitly provides the action, predicate, or attribute required by the claim.
covered_hypotheses.target_slot_identity: The evidence explicitly provides the identity of the target information slot required by the claim.
covered_hypotheses.target_value: The evidence explicitly provides the decisive target value asserted or denied by the claim.
covered_hypotheses.temporal_scope: The evidence explicitly provides the time period required by the claim.
covered_hypotheses.location_scope: The evidence explicitly provides the geographic or location scope required by the claim.
covered_hypotheses.organizational_scope: The evidence explicitly provides the organizational unit or queue required by the claim.
covered_hypotheses.conditional_scope: The evidence explicitly provides the condition or trigger required by the claim.
covered_hypotheses.modality_quantification_scope: The evidence explicitly provides the obligation, permission, and quantification scope required by the claim.

missing_hypotheses.entity: The evidence leaves unresolved or does not provide the subject or entity required by the claim.
missing_hypotheses.predicate: The evidence leaves unresolved or does not provide the action, predicate, or attribute required by the claim.
missing_hypotheses.target_slot_identity: The evidence leaves unresolved or does not provide the identity of the target information slot required by the claim.
missing_hypotheses.target_value: The evidence leaves unresolved or does not provide the decisive target value asserted or denied by the claim.
missing_hypotheses.temporal_scope: The evidence leaves unresolved or does not provide the time period required by the claim.
missing_hypotheses.location_scope: The evidence leaves unresolved or does not provide the geographic or location scope required by the claim.
missing_hypotheses.organizational_scope: The evidence leaves unresolved or does not provide the organizational unit or queue required by the claim.
missing_hypotheses.conditional_scope: The evidence leaves unresolved or does not provide the condition or trigger required by the claim.
missing_hypotheses.modality_quantification_scope: The evidence leaves unresolved or does not provide the obligation, permission, and quantification scope required by the claim.

coverage.decision: covered iff P(COVERED) >= global coverage threshold
coverage.pair_rule: SUFFICIENT iff selected compatible span covers every decisive slot
coverage.set_rule: discard incompatible spans; union slot coverage across compatible spans by maximum P(COVERED); SUFFICIENT iff every decisive slot is covered

polarity.combined_set_rule: otherwise concatenate compatible spans in registered order and classify SUPPORTS versus REFUTES if the set is sufficient
polarity.conflict_rule: if at least one individually sufficient compatible span SUPPORTS and at least one individually sufficient compatible span REFUTES, set relation is CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE
polarity.decision: argmax across entailment logits; earliest label on exact tie

hypotheses.SUPPORTS: The evidence supports the claim as written.
hypotheses.REFUTES: The evidence refutes the claim as written.

selection_order: prefer candidates satisfying every readiness requirement
maximize number of readiness requirements passed
maximize minimum of compatible_recall, incompatible_recall, sufficient_recall, insufficient_recall, supports_recall, refutes_recall, entailed_recall, contradicted_recall, unknown_recall
